objective: Collect a request, determine the required approver, obtain approval, record the outcome, and notify the requester.
unresolved_blockers: Identify the authoritative system that owns request and approval state; use Dataverse only if no suitable owner exists and its data requirements justify it.

harness.rationale: The conversational agent is the request interface and no alternative harness has a material advantage on current facts.
harness.dependency: Validate supported authoring access during preflight.

knowledge.selection: Not required unless approver policy is maintained as reference content
knowledge.rationale: The objective does not name a knowledge source; approver determination may instead be governed workflow logic or an authoritative directory.
knowledge.dependency: Clarify the authoritative approver rule and data source.

skills.rationale: No reusable procedural content is stated beyond workflow behavior.

tools_actions.selection: Agent request collection and status interaction
tools_actions.rationale: The agent collects user inputs while deterministic actions are assigned to the workflow.
tools_actions.dependency: Confirm request fields and channel during specification.

power_automate.rationale: Approver routing, approval, recording, notification, and recovery form deterministic multi-step behavior.
power_automate.dependency: Resolve connectors and operation details during preflight; none are assumed here.

dataverse_state.selection: Use the authoritative persistent state owner; Dataverse only if no suitable owner exists
dataverse_state.rationale: The process requires durable request and approval state, but no owner is named yet. Dataverse is conditional, not assumed.
dataverse_state.dependency: Identify existing authoritative state system and assess structured data/security needs.

agents.rationale: The request and approval lifecycle is one responsibility; the flow provides the execution boundary.

external_integrations.selection: Not selected until authoritative state, approver, and notification systems are identified
external_integrations.rationale: No system, connector, or operation is supplied by the objective.
external_integrations.dependency: Resolve system owners and permitted operations in clarification/preflight.

custom_development.rationale: Native agent, approval, and flow capabilities should be assessed before custom development.
